notes:
# Waymark 0.5.6

- Fixed Empyrean Trace completion saving after reopening the map or switching focus. A repeated observation of an already recorded checkmark could conflict with its earlier timestamp and prevent new completions later in the same scan from being saved.
- Repeated permanent completion checks are now idempotent for each character. Existing evidence stays intact, newly recognized traces continue saving, and revisiting a completed location does not add duplicate history.
- Connection > Tracking status > Detection coverage now explains whether trace checks are reading the map, waiting for character identification, unsupported on the current map, or retrying a save/read failure.
- Automatic trace completion still requires the foreground Verteron world map with the game's completed-trace icons visible. A direct pickup-event decoder and other maps are not supported yet. Missing icons and proximity never imply completion.
